title: Core-mutex gating and pthread static/dynamic mutex allocation

scope.rationale: These configuration fields and two complete allocation functions form the internal sqlite3MutexAlloc closure used to acquire STATIC_MEM and also preserve dynamic fast/recursive allocation and OOM semantics.
excluded_responsibilities: Mutex subsystem default-method selection and initialization

external_source_responsibilities: SQLite allocator integration for dynamic mutex storage
dependencies.caller_closure: Core gating, configured xMutexAlloc dispatch, pthread dynamic allocation, and all twelve stable static identities are assigned. Public auto-init and destruction remain separate.

inputs: Mutex kind 0 through 13 and configured core-mutex mode/method table
outputs: Null when core mutexing is disabled or dynamic allocation fails; fresh dynamic mutex for kinds 0/1; stable process mutex identity for kinds 2 through 13
contracts.ownership: Dynamic mutex ownership transfers to caller until mutex free. Static mutexes are process-lifetime borrowed identities.
contracts.state_and_results: Recursive kind supports recursive entry; fast/static kinds are non-recursive. Repeated static requests return the same address, including allocator STATIC_MEM.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Allocation does not enter the returned mutex. Configured xMutexAlloc may allocate. No I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Dynamic OOM returns null without leaked storage; later allocations continue. Static allocation cannot fail while core mutexing is enabled.

representation_differences: C pthreadMutexAlloc owns a function-local static array; Zig owns one process_static_mutexes array shared by public mutex transport and memory.Manager.
C dynamic mutex storage is zero-allocated through sqlite3MallocZero; Subsystem uses its injected allocator and initializes every field explicitly.
C recursive mutex uses pthread recursive attributes; Zig uses owner/depth tracking over a native mutex with equivalent visible entry/leave semantics.

oracle.protocol: Infrastructure differential compares all runtime modes, repeated STATIC_MEM identity, recursive dynamic behavior, contention, configured xMutexAlloc dispatch, and initialization ordering. Native tests exhaust dynamic allocation failures and prove process STATIC_MEM is shared with memory.Manager.
oracle.normalization: Dynamic addresses and implementation-specific recursive mutex bytes are normalized to identities; nullability, static equality, kind, callbacks, and lock behavior are exact.

assurance.oom: All deterministic dynamic allocation failure positions are tested sticky and one-shot. Static identities allocate no heap.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O. Static identity and contended recursive operation are tested; process-wide initialization races remain open.
assurance.malformed_input: Kinds 0 through 13 are in scope; API armor is disabled in the profile.
assurance.continuation: Allocation after induced OOM and repeated static lookup continue correctly.
assurance.performance: Static lookup is indexed constant time; recursive manual tracking overhead needs review.

integration.native_call_path: memory.Manager.lock points at processStatic(.static_mem); public static mutex allocation routes to the same process array.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The duplicate public_api.zig static mutex array was removed.

independent_review.notes: Must verify static identity integration, configured transport, recursive implementation difference, OOM, and concurrency.

known_blockers: Configured lifecycle is integrated; public auto-initialization event equivalence and final typed configuration remain open.
